_comment: Option D — UN/CEFACT codes in payload. Shown for comparison. Rejected for primary use: hurts human readability and several domain units have no Rec 20 code.
_readabilityCheck: A human reading 'uom: 2X' has to look up that 2X = m/min. 'uom: m/min' needs no lookup. For a standard whose audience is implementers, this matters.
_gapsInRec20: %RH, dpi, dE2000, pcs/h have no native Rec 20 codes — we'd be inventing our own extensions and end up with two systems.
